# Writing Minimal Sufficient Code

## Core principle

Minimize code, dependencies, layers, and state while fully satisfying contracts, risks, and operability. Activate only when the typed entry conditions are present; stop rather than inventing a missing tool, decision, or proof.

## When not to use

- a deliberate framework migration requiring broader change
- generated code whose size is fixed by schema
